display_long_description:
Learn the ‘how’ of flying - procedures, flows and systems inside a realistic VR cockpit you fly with your hands.  PlaneVR is a VR procedural training system by IAG XR, built for student and professional pilots who want to practice procedures, cockpit flows, and systems interaction in an immersive environment anytime, without needing access to a real aircraft.
Learn to fly a Bristell Classic in VR using your hands, in a realistic cockpit, build confidence through repetition.  Interacting naturally with switches, levers and instruments via hand tracking to develop muscle memory for checklists and normal/non‑normal procedures.

Best for:
• Students practising between lessons
• Qualified pilots refreshing flows
• Instructors/schools delivering consistent training

Now in PlaneVR:
• Hands‑on hand‑tracking cockpit interaction
• Procedure‑focused practice: checklists, systems, emergency/non‑normal rehearsal
• Cost‑effective training without aircraft/sim time
• Streamlined Meta‑credential login + redesigned menus (user‑feedback driven)
• Foundations for cockpit, aircraft airport customization, performance tracking and analytics

Coming in 2026 (staged add‑ons & subscriptions):
• Additional aircraft (incl. custom skins/paint options)
• New airfields and training locations
• Networking/multiplayer for Instructor–Student shared cockpit and remote coaching
• Video Logbook + lesson capture/iCast recordings
• Flight School subscriptions LMS integration.
Wishlist for updates.
